notes.title: Demo 1.4.2 Update
notes.notes:
A new demo version 1.4.2 has been released. Let's have a look at the improvements and bugfixes:
[list]
[*] fixed issue where the game did not start for some players
[*] lockpicking - it is now shown if you have enough DEX to open a chest
[*] fixed issue where some players got stuck at the randomly placed objects of the mountain path
[*] changed the scaling of the blood weapons to scale with VIT
[*] changed the balancing of some of the blood dungeon enemies
[*] crystal bulwark boss is now slightly more challenging
[*] fixed the blood splatter of the orc skeletons
[*] changed the placement of the goblin cave entrance
[*] outlaw mine entrance is now more obvious
[/list]

Unfortunately, as the Steam Next Fest is over, the maximum level cap achievable in the demo is decreased once again to level 10. But don't worry, the level cap in the final release will we way higher.

Again, thank you all so much for playing the demo and your feedback. Without your support and valuable feedback this game would not be as it is today.

Have a great day,
Lukas

notes.title: Demo 1.4.0 Update
notes.notes:
For the last few months amazing new features, gameplay changes and other improvements have been added. Pale Coins has now reached a state which I am excited about.

[previewyoutube=lF6qv6oMBzo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Exploration[/h1]

For me, exploration is one of the things that keep me coming back to games. With the release of the new demo, many new possibilities to find items and gold were added. While adding more to uncover, the map sizes were reduced to allow for denser maps.

[h1]Combat[/h1]
Thanks to great feedback in the recent months, the combat in Pale Coins was made faster and more engaging. The stamina consumption for basic attacks was removed and changed for the special attacks and dodge mechanics.

[h1]Items[/h1]
Itemization is a huge aspect of ARPGs. Therefore, I wanted to improve on the itemization as much as possible, to really give you the option to build your character that you want to play.
Besides new armor types - such as gloves and boots - sockets and gems were introduced. They can be socketed in any gear with open sockets to improve your damage, defense or resistances, or grant bonuses to help you on your journey.

[h1]New Demo Boss[/h1]
A new dungeon and boss was added to the demo to give you a taste of the end-game possibilities. This dungeon is hidden in the wasteland and may be activated with a special item, which can be farmed.

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
A change which I am very excited about is the NPC portraits. This really has a huge impact on the dialogues.
Also, the design of some areas were improved by adding new FX, adding new objects or by re-designing the region.

[h1]Mods[/h1]
To provide even more content a very basic mod support was added. You can create your own worlds, items, NPCs and enemies with only a few configurations.
I am working on a documentation on how to create your own content and will release it as soon as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/453832054f12e20014e09ee1e74349ff5a40e38c.png[/img]

Make sure to download and test the demo yourself and have fun.

Come visit the Discord server and let's talk about Pale Coins and other games: [url=https://discord.gg/3nu8PHwUjX]Discord[/url]


Thank you so much and have a great day,
Lukas

notes.title: September Update
notes.notes:
Hey there,
Let's have a look at the progress made in September and the roadmap of 2024 and 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/02d5ce36c281f105d0f6c1426c9da0cb903ed7d2.png[/img]

[h1]Modding[/h1]
Enabling Mod support has become the most important feature on my list lately. I've been thinking a lot on when and how to enable mods for you. Ultimately, giving you the option to create your own content in Pale Coins as soon as possible sounded excellent.
Even though the final release might still take a while, you should be able to add and create your own content until then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/b5ddf85212ea2d4068b60f2239f14434ac96a244.png[/img]

Everything in the image above is modded content. The world, the room, the weapon, the armor and even the equipped artefact is loaded externally. All of the needed configs and sprites can be placed in separate mod folders with the option to enable or disable them.

A guide on how to mod your own content will be released eventually.


[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
[h2]Demo Update[/h2]
In the last few months huge progress was made on gameplay improvements, immersion, QoL features and - as mentioned before - mod support.
The next logical step is to let you decide if you like the direction Pale Coins is going towards. Therefore, a new demo version will be released in October, which lets you experience the world of Grenmark in a  new light. And possibly with new, community created, content.

Obviously, mod support is still in the works and needs more testing. As soon as I feel comfortable with the test coverage, I'll let you know and release a new version.

[h2]New Trailer[/h2]
Behind the scenes, a new trailer has been worked on for a few months. This has been the most challenging excersise for me so far in terms of video editing, pacing and actually finishing the whole thing.
The trailer will be released around the time the new demo releases. I am looking forward to that as well.

[h2]What's planned for 2024?[/h2]
After the release of the new demo I want to get back to the different regions in Pale Coins.
Some of them need to be reworked, such as the capital. Others are still missing and have to be implemented.
By the end of the year, I want to have a majority of the regions and dungeons finished.

[h2]What's planned for 2025?[/h2]
Unfortunately, I won't be able to finish everything needed in 2024. Therefore, development will go on in 2025.
The following is planned until the final release:
[list]
[*] finish all mandatory regions
[*] finish all mandatory bosses
[*] mid- and late-game items and skills
[*] factions
[*] pets / companions
[*] more questlines
[*] different game modes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/453832054f12e20014e09ee1e74349ff5a40e38c.png[/img]

I am looking forward to the release of the new demo, the trailer and, most importantly, your feedback.

Thank you so much for sticking around and your support. I really appreciate every single wishlist, comment and mention.

Have a great day and see you next time,
Lukas

Summary:
[list]
[*] a new procedurally generated dungeon
[*] a new dungeon boss
[*] Crystal Bulwark boss re-design
[*] finalized the academy layout

[url=https://discord.gg/3nu8PHwUjX] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/b656aed87ee6098f29d7328dafeb0b77cd487ad1.png[/img] [/url]

[h1] - the blood dungeon - [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/d8ed4077571d15a662610fb253eb4c4fba96daca.png[/img]
After sacrificing a certain key item at the blood altar in the wasteland you’ll be teleported to the blood dungeon. This dungeon is different every time you conquer it’s planes and features a lot of foes to fight.
Upon defeating a majority of the enemies the blood portal activates and you may enter the next plane. 


[h1] - the Gazer - [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/38addd4bdb083c687f15b4d098ab5f3399b860de.png[/img]
The true test of skill awaits you at the end of the blood dungeon - the Gazer.
This boss is capable of reducing your health to a minimum with it’s laser beam and teeth. Not only does the Gazer inflict a lot of damage, but he also summons tentacles randomly which may cause troubles.

[h1] - Crystal Bulwark boss re-design - [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/212da909d5d1bdb841967959fd0eaf1f60660e2c.png[/img]
Recently I decided to redesign the Crystal Bulwark boss as I’ve been working hard on improving my pixel-art skills in the last few weeks and months.
What do you think about the re-design?

[h1] - finalized the Academy layout - [/h1]
The academy of the wizards is now complete and features NPCs with different quests and information about Grenmark.
In the future I want to add more NPCs to the academy and also enable the player to join the wizards.

[h1] - new item slots for boots and gloves - [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/f7f6247195b4abded8d974957cacd628993fccbc.png[/img]
Now, this change is something I am very excited about. You now have two more equipment slots to work with. Along with the improved item modifications, you have so much equipment to choose from and build your character exactly like you need to.

[h1] - new mid-game items and skills - [/h1]
One of my new favorite things to do is to dash at enemies with two-handed greatswords or axes. The Greatsword Dash is an AoE attack which slices through enemies in a straight line.
Additionally, spears got a new skill as well - the multi-thrust. While the damage of each thrust is slightly reduced, this still does more damage than a basic attack.
Along with the new skills new items were added as well for you to find.



That's all the progress in June.
I am looking forward to the development in July and thank you so much for reading.
Make sure to wishlist Pale Coins to support the development.

Thank you so much and have a great day,
Lukas

notes.title: May Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/9f04173f24bc0586d3578c62a05f5b407c9f2324.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/3nu8PHwUjX] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/b656aed87ee6098f29d7328dafeb0b77cd487ad1.png[/img] [/url]


May has been an interesting month for the development of Pale Coins.
As I've received great feedback lately about the current state of the game, and several ideas on how to improve the gameplay and items, I decided to add new mechanics, as well as change existing mechanics.

[h1]Improved Exploration[/h1]
Exploration is key in Pale Coins, therefore you may want to search every corner of a map to find new gear, interesting stuff, and special enemies.
However, I had to realise that there was no reason to visit a map multiple times, which ended up making them boring.

[h2]Less map sizes[/h2]
Most map sizes were reduced, to remove unnecessarily long paths to certain destinations. As a side effect, searching for stuff in maps is more efficient and makes it more fun.

[h2]Sprinting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/67e24317189bad4594cd874f06a33b6f4f13510e.png[/img]
Talking about more efficient and more fun: Sprinting is now a thing!
You are now able to move faster by sprinting around the map. It uses stamina, so be careful around enemies, as you may want to have some stamina left to dodge.

[h2]No Enemy Respawn[/h2]
Enemies stay dead per session. As you may visit maps more than once, it sometimes felt tedious to deal with the same enemies over and over again.
This is now changed, as you have to reload the game, to make enemies respawn.

[h2]Elite Enemies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/7d437fc538c3238bd9cc7eb18a25ab36babfc761.png[/img]
You will encounter new enemies which are way stronger than their common variation. These enemies will spawn after certain events in the main story, and will be placed randomly each session.
They also drop rare materials to use later in the game.

[h2]Random item pickups[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/83eea8d329c3506850b495321de08cc93a2dbeaa.png[/img]
To make exploration more fun, I added new stuff to inspect and loot in the wasteland.
Corpses will spawn randomly per session, which drop gold and sometimes recovery items.
I think they are a great addition and want to add them to other areas as well in the future.

[h1]Items[/h1]
I've been thinking a lot about items and how to improve them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/5285563869e9773e2532608e60ebf0c8e95fcaac.png[/img]

[h2]Item Modifications and stats[/h2]
I wanted to make items and their stats more meaningful. I felt like the items were boring, as there was almost no difference besides the damage or the defense.
A friend of mine suggested adding random modification to all items, based on their level. This has the side effect, that you may want to keep low level items with certain modifications, as they may give a buff to a build you are trying to make.
Also, I removed the resistances of common items, so you are more dependent on the item modifications.

[h2]Dodge / Block mechanics[/h2]
The overall speed of the gameplay increased by adding sprinting and having smaller maps. I want to add more speed and variation to the combat as well, so I figured to add default dodge mechanics.
I started with a short backstep on greatswords. This one has few iframes, but is sufficient to gain distance and eventually dodge an attack.
Following this, I want to add a block mechanic and shields, so that one-handed weapons are no longer inferior to two-handed weapons.

[h1]Academy[/h1]
Progress was made in the academy region as well. All buildings are placed and a few NPCs have been added already.
One of my new favourite NPCs is working hard in the academy. He is a winemaker and has a lot of wine to taste.

[h1]UI Overhaul[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/7e4a53f95661e1e498c75bfd0cb2b2cd3451a3a6.png[/img]
I had some spare time and decided to update most of the UI elements. A new font was introduced as well, as the previous font was hard to read at times.



That's all for now.
Make sure to wishlist Pale Coins and support the development.

Thank you so much and have a great day,
Lukas

Hmm... Is that a... face?

[h2]Fire Spells[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/0af766853e165ef6b6b2fb825528596b56d05feb.gif[/img]
One of my favourite spells in any game is a fire rain - definitely not a Gothic reference - so I added this new fire spell.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/453832054f12e20014e09ee1e74349ff5a40e38c.png[/img]

[h1]What's next[/h1]
Right now I am working on new regions such as the academy of the wizards. Also, I am planning on updating the captial in the near future. I was impressed by the city Archolos from the Gothic II Mod "The Chronicles Of Myrtana: Archolos", which I may use as a reference for the re-design. Obviously, due to limited time, I won't be able to create a city as big as Archolos.

Another important thing on my to-do list is to create default dodge/shield abilities. Currently, you'd have to find gear with dodge skills, if you want to dodge attacks.
It may by way cooler to have default mechanics to dodge or shield attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/453832054f12e20014e09ee1e74349ff5a40e38c.png[/img]

That s all for now.
Let me know what you think and join the Discord server if you want to talk about the game with me or others.
Also, please wishlist Pale Coins if you like what you see.

Best regards,
Lukas

notes.title: March Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/ea6e5ced635d6d64353103bc393747feb8eae33e.png[/img]

[h1]Dungeon improvements[/h1]
The goal for march was to finish the latest dungeon and finish the implementation of the dungeon boss. Also, several improvements had to be made to the dungeon to increase the overall experience.

[h2]New enemies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/585a5fee6b8acba5e77f36edcbca4189ab06e80f.gif[/img]
Along with the dungeon boss, new enemy types were introduced lately. One is some sort of a mini boss, guarding one of the needed items to complete the dungeon, while the other enemy has a burning passion to ruin your day. (Pun definitely intended)

[h2]Dungeon boss[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/9db71110f984644f0e67f0484ba8a7db9a87f070.gif[/img]
The mechanics of the boss are similar to another boss in Pale Coins. However, this one has an addition which makes it harder for ranged characters. Don’t worry, I won’t spoil what it is.

[h1]3D Sound SFX[/h1]
Up to this point almost all sound FX had the same volume regardless of the distance.
Now, SFX are based on the position where the sound emits. In case an SFX is played at the right side of the player, you will also hear that from the right side of your speaker or headphones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/0aeecc826ce655e119dad7a6ac1cc0ad4e0b7ddc.png[/img]
In the example above you can see three SFX and their distances. The outer left torch is outside of the hearing range and is therefore not heard. The other torch and the hammer sound are within range, so you can hear them.
Also, the sound of the hammer is just within range which makes it quieter naturally.

[h1]Steam page update[/h1]
It is worth mentioning that the Steam page of Pale Coins got a slight overhaul.
Now you can see several gifs showcasing gameplay of the game. The descriptions were changed as well to focus on the important information.


That's all for this month's update.
Let me know what you think. I'd really appreciate any kind of feedback.
Thank you sou much for reading and see you in the next update!

Have a great day,
Lukas

notes.title: February Update
notes.notes:
Hey y'all,
there's been a lot of progress in the past months. So, I wanted to give you a quick update:

[h1]New Tower[/h1]
The newest tower (or dungeon) in Pale Coins is built around an elevator gimmick. The idea is to activate the elevator before being able to move up to the next floor. On the next floor, you'll have to activate the elevator again to continue.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/151bd67fab7b91ad74cb220322e2fc5e86f6733e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/4f80da3720a7898cd6d44ecda388e9bd165aa022.png[/img]

The tower itself is located in the middle of a lake, surrounded by ruins. 
Why are there ruins? Why is the tower not destroyed such as the buildings nearby? What secrets lie inside the tower? You'll have to find the answers yourself ;)


[h1]Crafting[/h1]
You are now able to find random blueprints on your adventures. These blueprints, and the corresponding items, are needed to craft items at smiths, alchemists, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/ead737d66a9656c45139173a2c0cc0fbcd113632.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/a331d57c342f9504b951d493d2550d2c0fa8c689.png[/img]

(Don't worry... The crafting mechanic is totally optional and limited to items.)

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[h2]Transparency shader[/h2]
Some time ago it was mentioned that the visibility behind trees was... bad. This issue got resolved by adding a shader which lets you see through the trees. Here's an example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/d4ab2e411c92a906f979de9dec5bdd88bbdcc8fd.png[/img]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
Maps are a thing now. Some merchants have maps of the region for sale. 
In this example the map of Grenmark is shown:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44171629/a7bd9c0587a659e1c94ad606c10f0a244732d0e4.png[/img]

Note: There are still no map markers or something like that planned.

[h2]Custom HUD[/h2]
Not everyone likes to have the screen full of information. Therefore, I added a setting which lets you change the HUD style to reduce the information shown on screen.



That's all for now.
I am very happy with the progress so far. Let me know what you think. I'd really appreciate any kind of feedback.
Thank you sou much!


Have a great day,
Lukas
